title: Har dam hussain
body:
har dam hussain tera gham hussain
hai yehi dua har momin ki
rahe aankh hamari nam hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tasveer e payambar kai gham mein
ye saara aalam rota hai
ghar ghar mein majlis jaari hai
ghar ghar mein matam hota hai
zanjeer se matam akbar ka
ta hashr karenge hum hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon hyder ka hai asghar mein
is baat ko hurmal bhool gaya
tha teer e sitam halqoom pe jo
naize pe jhoola jhool gaya
hai kar gaya saare aalam ki
har aankh ko wo purnam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom jawani qasim ki
ab chain se khaak pe soti hai
kar kar ke yaad samandar ko
karbal ki zameen bhi roti hai
jis tarha hua tukde tukde
maqtal mein tera qasim hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
le pursa us masooma ka
kaano se jis ke khoon baha
jo dafn hui zanjeeron mein
jala kurta jis ko kafan mila
takraati thi jo sar zindan se
ro kehti thi har dam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
na sar ko jhukane paaye layeen
chaaha tha jhukana jis sar ko
khud apne saron se bhi ooncha
pada unko uthana jis sar ko
goh kat gaya tera sar lekin
phir bhi na hua ye kham hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dam karo sunnat hai matam
hai karte rahe ye khud khaatam
na rokne se ruk payega
badta hi rahega ye matam
zainab ki dua hai ye matam
hoga na kabhi ye kam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai paak mohamed ka
ban mein hasta basta gulshan
karti hai matam zainab ka
khursheed ke dil ki har dhadkan
tere akbar qasim asghar ka
har saans mein matam hussain
har dam hussain...
author: Haider Khursheed
